question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
SELECT p.player_name
FROM ball_by_ball bb
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
  AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
  AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
  AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
JOIN player_match pm ON bb.match_id = pm.match_id AND bb.striker = pm.player_id
JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON bb.striker = p.player_id
WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
  AND pm.team_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pm.team_id != m.match_winner
  AND bs.runs_scored IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker, bb.team_batting, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
ORDER BY p.player_name

{"sql": "SELECT bb.match_id, m.match_winner, m.team_1, m.team_2, pm.team_id, p.player_name, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
FROM ball_by_ball bb
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
  AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
  AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
  AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
JOIN player_match pm ON bb.match_id = pm.match_id AND bb.striker = pm.player_id
JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON bb.striker = p.player_id
WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
  AND pm.team_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pm.team_id != m.match_winner
  AND bs.runs_scored IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY bb.match_id, m.match_winner, m.team_1, m.team_2, pm.team_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
ORDER BY p.player_name"}
